set.body:
Files: tools/ci/first-level-benchmark.sh, tools/benchmark/finalize_first_level_receipt.py, tools/benchmark/first-level-budgets.json, docs/benchmarks/first-level.md; receipts/logs go in an external or target evidence directory during qualification.
Precondition: the identity repair and benchmark/report input contract are settled in one clean candidate. Record full source/provider revisions, runtime/OS/CPU, exact parameters and fixture/workload hashes. Run the existing full JMH profile with GC/allocation measurement; retain raw output. Cover planning, repeated fitting/chunking and existing HRF/WLS/GLS workloads. Compare with the retained baseline using unchanged budgets and inputs.
Acceptance: the receipt validator accepts the fresh exact-candidate receipt, all required workload/parameter rows exist, allocation and timing conclusions are explicit, and raw logs can regenerate the receipt. Pay attention to ownership-copy cost at planning versus per-response/per-chunk cost; no extra fingerprint/QR work per voxel. Investigate any regression instead of increasing tolerances/budgets to make the receipt green. Do not claim portable JS performance from JVM JMH. Final release remains P4.4j.
set.title: P4.4i: refresh performance evidence on the admitted immutable-design candidate
